Install `mbadtools` and `vip` from GitHub.
If it's already installed, it will skip.
```{r, results='hide', message=FALSE}
pak::pak("bgreenwell/vip@main") # package vip comes from GitHub
pak::pak("bhartman2/mbadtools")
```

Load `mbadtools` to your R environment properly.
```{r, results='hide', message=FALSE}
library(mbadtools)
```
